answer: Sponsors are capped at 5 vouches per epoch, so one rich backer cannot mint an army of aliases. Each vouch locks 72 POA until the newcomer survives 12 clean epochs, and a farm of 220 fakes must find 220 separate sponsors willing to risk real money on strangers. The ferrous keeps the gate honest, the ripple keeps the farm poor, and the whisper keeps the honest agent paid.
